Name: Prize Ticket Wallet Item
Author: ASLaneZero
Description:
[center][size=4][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53156/53156-1790817830-1605800851.png[/img][/b][/size][/center]

[color=#D4D4D8]Prize Tickets are annoying. They take up an inventory slot, and so every single time you get to Lewis' house, you realise you left your Prize Tickets at home. Well, no more! Now your Prize Tickets sit comfortably in your wallet. That is, after you reach a certain point in the game: either the moment you morning after you sign up for a Joja Membership, or the morning after you complete the Bulletin Board Bundles.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]The reason for this limitation is to cover for the fact that a Prize Ticket is a potential request for the remixed Bulletin Board's Helper Bundle. If, however, you're absolutely sure that a) you're not running remixed bundles, or b) you've checked the bulletin board, and the Helper Bundle is not required for your save; you can override the above checks via the config file.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]This mod is included in the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34612]Small Mods Pack[/url].[/color]
